tasks.task: I’m covering QC today and need Chen Jie’s mailbox cleaned up before noon. Please: (1) verify which folders exist in chen.jie@acme-qc.com, (2) search the mailbox for emails with subject containing “Calibration” so I can confirm we won’t delete anything critical, (3) if none of those are in the INBOX, clear the INBOX, and (4) confirm the INBOX is empty afterward. If there are Calibration-subject emails in INBOX, do NOT clear it; instead email huang.ling@acme-qc.com with the count and subjects so she can decide.

Step 3 shows the INBOX is empty (returned list contains zero messages) after Step 2 cleared it.
A confirmation email is sent to huang.ling@acme-qc.com (Step 4 returns created message details) including the verification output from Step 3.
